title: Part Number and Part Name are required to save a new part
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold "Part Library & Inventory - Create & Edit". Open New Inventory Part.
custom_steps:
1. Leave Part Number empty and try to save; read the error.
  2. Leave Part Name empty and try to save; read the error.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Part Number is required and Part Name is required; if either is empty on save the system shows an error on that field and does not save.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 7 (Create a part without a library item); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.
